-- Migration: Add user activity tracking tables
-- Author: Backend Team
-- Date: 2024-03-15
-- Description: Creates tables for tracking user sessions, page views,
-- and API calls. Includes indexes for common query patterns and a
-- materialized view for the analytics dashboard.

BEGIN;

-- Create the sessions table to track user login sessions.
-- Each session has a unique ID and is linked to a user account.
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS user_sessions (
    id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
    user_id BIGINT NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    started_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(),
    ended_at TIMESTAMPTZ,
    ip_address INET NOT NULL,
    user_agent TEXT,
    is_active BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT TRUE,
    metadata JSONB DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb
);

-- Index for finding active sessions by user (most common query pattern).
CREATE INDEX idx_sessions_user_active
    ON user_sessions (user_id, is_active)
    WHERE is_active = TRUE;

-- Page views are the most frequent event type. We partition by month
-- to keep query performance manageable as the table grows.
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS page_views (
    id BIGSERIAL,
    session_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES user_sessions(id),
    url TEXT NOT NULL,
    referrer TEXT,
    viewed_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(),
    duration_ms INTEGER,
    PRIMARY KEY (id, viewed_at)
) PARTITION BY RANGE (viewed_at);

-- Create partitions for the current and next quarter.
CREATE TABLE page_views_2024_q1 PARTITION OF page_views
    FOR VALUES FROM ('2024-01-01') TO ('2024-04-01');
CREATE TABLE page_views_2024_q2 PARTITION OF page_views
    FOR VALUES FROM ('2024-04-01') TO ('2024-07-01');

-- Materialized view for the daily active users dashboard widget.
-- Refreshed every 15 minutes by a background job.
CREATE MATERIALIZED VIEW daily_active_users AS
SELECT
    DATE_TRUNC('day', s.started_at) AS day,
    COUNT(DISTINCT s.user_id) AS active_users,
    COUNT(DISTINCT s.id) AS total_sessions,
    AVG(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (COALESCE(s.ended_at, NOW()) - s.started_at))) AS avg_session_duration_seconds
FROM user_sessions s
WHERE s.started_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '90 days'
GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('day', s.started_at)
ORDER BY day DESC;

CREATE UNIQUE INDEX idx_dau_day ON daily_active_users (day);

COMMIT;
